query: Which small-cluster inference procedures (wild-cluster bootstrap, randomization inference, permutation tests with spatial dependence corrections) should be mandatory when macro clusters are few?

response.query: Which small-cluster inference procedures (wild-cluster bootstrap, randomization inference, permutation tests with spatial dependence corrections) should be mandatory when macro clusters are few?
response.answer: When macro clusters are few, wild cluster bootstrap and randomization inference are mandatory small-cluster inference procedures. They address issues when traditional cluster-robust inference fails due to small cluster sizes.

results.title: Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference For Few Treated Clusters
results.content:
Title: Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference For Few Treated Clusters
IDEAS home Printed from https://ideas.repec.org/p/qed/wpaper/1404.html. # Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference For Few Treated Clusters. Although procedures based on the wild cluster bootstrap often work well when the number of treated clusters is not too small, they can either over-reject or under-reject seriously when it is. In a previous paper, we showed that procedures based on randomization inference (RI) can work well in such cases. We propose a bootstrap-based alternative to randomization inference, whichmitigates the discrete nature of RI P values in the few-clusters case.
